runtime: Official game starters, appearances and minute targets already used by v47 retained. validation: Compare full season per-appearance actual minute MAE, regulation target MAE; strict phase occupancy and teammate overlap MAE. Source and simulation timing use exact elapsed intervals. Test invariants no duplicate, five eligible, protected player, legal dead-ball substitution, disabled parity; report full individual/team/defense regression. Rotation acceptance requires four-season mean minutes, phase and overlap MAE improve, no season minutes MAE worsens, no disqualifying eligibility/clock failure.
